parts.label: central rover chassis and raised deck
parts.appearance: elongated chamfered rectangular box with a slightly raised trapezoidal top panel, positioned horizontally at the center above the six wheels

parts.label: left solar panel
parts.appearance: long thin flat rectangular panel with a shallow raised perimeter frame, mounted along the left edge of the upper deck

parts.label: right solar panel
parts.appearance: long thin flat rectangular panel with a shallow raised perimeter frame, mounted along the right edge of the upper deck

parts.label: rear sensor mast
parts.appearance: tall cylindrical vertical shaft with broad ring shaped collars at its lower and upper ends, rising above the rear center of the chassis

parts.label: binocular sensor head
parts.appearance: wide chamfered rectangular head with two large circular recessed lenses on its front face, mounted horizontally on top of the vertical mast

parts.label: front arm shoulder base
parts.appearance: short vertical cylindrical pedestal topped by a thick upright circular hinge housing, positioned at the front center of the rover deck

parts.label: raised sample arm upper link
parts.appearance: long tapered rectangular link with round pivot housings at both ends, sloping upward and forward from the shoulder to a raised elbow

parts.label: descending sample arm forearm
parts.appearance: slender tapered rectangular link with round joint caps at both ends, sloping downward and forward from the raised elbow to the wrist

parts.label: left gripper finger
parts.appearance: curved tapered pincer jaw with a small cylindrical root and narrow inward bent tip, extending forward below the wrist on the left side

parts.label: right gripper finger
parts.appearance: curved tapered pincer jaw with a small cylindrical root and narrow inward bent tip, extending forward below the wrist on the right side

parts.label: left front wheel

parts.label: left front suspension arm
parts.appearance: short broad bent rectangular beam with thick circular hinge ends, extending laterally and downward from the chassis to the left front wheel
